controls.kind: Synthetic controls; no native execution, download or real process signaling
Inventory and source-surface regressions on native Windows; not platform qualification

refinements: Preparation and package tests share an owned-session wait helper. Interrupted waits stop and reap the owned child before propagating the interruption.
ProcessLookupError during cleanup means the owned session has already ended; child reaping still runs.
The hidden preparation entry point refuses populated workspaces before downloads or writes. Preparation rechecks this condition independently.
Only an empty regular, non-symlink research-only marker is allowed in the fresh preparation workspace.
Existing preparation.json content is preserved when hidden preparation refuses a populated workspace.
independentReview: Pending closure on this exact refinement; preceding timeout, atomic checkpoint and preparation deadline findings were closed on inspection.

errors: Review is stale or missing: inspect changes and refresh sourceDigest
governance.owner: Implementation coordinator reviews and registers the final shared candidate; this worker does not refresh global attestations.

limits: No native CI dispatch, candidate push, task acceptance or phase advancement.
Real Compose, supported-host, recovery, security and full phase evidence remain required.
Earlier source-bound evidence remains historical, not current acceptance.
